Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE MS. SELINA S. PABILAN Administrative Officer IV Sta Margarita, Samar Dear Ms. Pabilan: DILG Legal Opinion No. 78 s. 2011 NOV 1 0 2011 This pertains to your letter seeking this Department's Opinion on why the Joint Circular did not include the expenditure for capability building or HRD activities for LGUs? Per your supplemental letter, you are scheduled to conduct a two day Ehem! Sensitivity Seminar, an HRD-reiated activity to be conducted by the Civil Service Commission Regional Office 8. Since only Fifty Thousand Pesos (P50,ooo.oo) was allocated for Capability- Building/HRD-related activities in the municipality's 20% Development Fund, you conferred first with Mayor Alfredo Serrano, Jr. on the required disbursement for the said activity. YOU were informed that such activity is no longer allowed to be funded out of the 20% Development Fund as prescribed by DILG and DBM Joint Circular No. 2011-11 dated 13 April 2011. Hence, your query, In reply thereto, we regret to inform you that we shall defer any further interpretation of the DILG-DBM JOINT MEMORANDUM CIRCULAR NO. 2011-1 as the DILG and the DBM are currently in the process of drafting the joint clarificatory guidelines for its implementation so as to illuminate the scope as well as the prohibited expense items enumerated therein. Further, please be informed that pursuant to the meeting held between the representatives of the Department and the DBM it was clarified therein that the above- mentioned JMC shall apply prospectively, i.e., for the CY 2012 budget. Hence, by necessary implication the governing issuance for the CY 2011 budget is DILG-DBM JMC No. 1, series of 2005. We hope the foregoing sufficiently addresses your concern. Very truly yours, A LS:94111 . JESUS Director Ill
